description: Fetch one US National Archives Catalog record in full by its NAID (National Archives Identifier, the number in a catalog.archives.gov/id/ URL). Returns title, scope and content note, dates, access and use restrictions, the full archival hierarchy back to the record group, and the digital objects attached. Example: nara_record({ naid: "219756158" })

naid.description: National Archives Identifier, e.g. "219756158" — the number in a catalog.archives.gov/id/ URL

name: nara_record
